newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler C.N Q3 net sets record, beats estimates.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler C.N Q3 net sets record, beats estimates.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said its third quarter net profit of $680 million, or $0.93 per fully diluted share, set new third-quarter records for net income and earnings per share.

The company's performance also exceeded Wall Street estimates. Excluding an after-tax charge of $55 million, or $0.07 a share, to cover the cost of an early retirement program for salaried employees, Chrysler's net operating income was $735 million, or $1.00 a share.
According to First Call Corp., the Wall Street consensus estimate for Chrysler was $0.69 a share.
